title: Signatory
description: One person who signed the manifesto. The file name must be <github username in lowercase>.yaml.

github.description: GitHub username. This is the verified identity of the signature.

role.description: engineering = builds software; people = People, HR or recruiting; other = everyone else.

company.description: Shown for identification only. It does not mean the company endorses the manifesto.

issue.description: Number of the issue that created this signature, when signed through the issue form.
